heading.title: Suits by or against military or naval men or airmen

article.title: Service on person so authorised, or on his pleader, to be good service.
article.content: Processes served upon any person authorised by an officer 4[soldier 5[, sailor] or airman] under rule 1 or upon any pleader appointed as aforesaid by such person shall he as effectual as if they had been served on the party in person.
article.html:
3Service on person so authorised, or on his pleader, to be good service.

Order 28, Rule 3

Processes served upon any person authorised by an officer 4[soldier 5[, sailor] or airman] under rule 1 or upon any pleader appointed as aforesaid by such person shall he as effectual as if they had been served on the party in person.

4 Subs. by s. 2, ibid., and Sch. I, for “or soldier” and “or a soldier”.

5 Ins. by Act 35 of 1934, s. 2 and Sch.
